battle.name: 萩之亂
battle.brief: 一八七六年二月，廢藩置縣與秩祿處分之後失去俸祿的萩藩舊士族起兵，攻燒郡役所，占據萩城總門及德山、長門一帶要道，與官軍對峙九十天。鎮壓由鎮台步兵、補充兵與警察隊完成，海上全程無軍艦介入；同年日本海軍只有對馬、敷高等鐵骨汽船，裝甲主力艦要到一八七七年才開始訂造。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的兩方力量對比極不對稱。一方是明治政府：大政官之下，內務省掌民政，主持廢藩置縣後的藩籍處理、秩祿處分的發放與警察制度，陸軍省掌兵制，一八七三年頒佈的徵兵令把徵兵權收歸國家，並以東京、熊本等鎮台為常備骨幹，補充兵與山砲隊為其附屬。萩之亂爆發時，內務卿三條實美在中央主持民政與警察線，陸軍大臣大山巌掌兵部與軍械調配，鎮台總監山縣有朋奉命率領鎮台步兵、補充兵與山口縣廳的警察隊南下，兵員總數以三千人計。另一方是前萩藩——毛利家支藩、表高四萬石的小藩——的舊士族所組成的義兵聯盟，以護國隊與神國隊為骨幹，附有在德山、三隅、豐浦與長門一帶聞風響應的舊藩士，武器只有舊式火槍、刀、槍與少量自製火藥，沒有海軍、沒有砲兵、沒有攻城器械，糧秣靠向町衆徵求。多數未參與的藩士保持沉默，這正是聯盟人數始終有限的原因。
countriesEn: The two sides were wildly unequal in strength. On one side stood the Meiji government: the Dajokan at the top, with the Home Ministry handling civil administration - the disposal of domain households after the abolition of the han, the payment of the commuted stipends and the police system - and the Army Ministry in charge of the military system, the Conscription Act of 1873 vesting the right to conscript in the state, and the garrison districts at Tokyo, Kumamoto and elsewhere forming the standing core, with reserve units and mountain artillery attached to them. When the Hagi revolt broke out, Home Minister Saneomi Sanjo directed the civil and police lines from Tokyo, War Minister Iwao Oyama held the Army Ministry and the allocation of ordnance, and Inspector-General of the Garrisons Aritomo Yamagata was ordered south with garrison infantry, conscripted reserves and the police detachments of the Yamaguchi prefectural government, three thousand men in all. On the other side stood the former samurai of Hagi - a small branch domain of the Mori clan with a nominal forty thousand koku - organised as a rebel alliance built on the Go-koku-tai and the Shinkoku-tai, joined by former retainers who rose in Tokuyama, Misumi, Toyoura and the Nagato district. Their weapons were old matchlock muskets, blades, spears and a little homemade powder; they had no navy, no artillery and no siege train, and they drew their food by requisition from the townsmen. Most retainers never joined, which is precisely why the alliance never grew large.
people: 起義一方的核心是三名萩藩出身的士族。前田利右衛門出身藩中家老職，一八七五年曾赴東京陳情，要求緩行秩祿處分，未獲俯允，回藩後成為護國隊總督，主導起義的整體部署與對官軍的交涉。三岡八郎是藩中劍術師範，以神國隊隊長身份參與，是最早主張以武力迫使政府讓步的激進派。佐々木勇出身舊藩士，赴薩摩方面活動，事發前被官府拘捕，於一八七六年在獄中切腹。青年士族頭山滿據傳曾參與策劃，事後被捕受罰，日後成為民權運動人物。官府一方，內務卿三條實美與陸軍大臣大山巌分別握民政與兵部之權，實際指揮鎮壓的是鎮台總監山縣有朋，他主張以新制軍隊而不是舊藩的武力來收場這場亂局。
peopleEn: The core of the rising was three Hagi-born samurai. Maeda Tsuemon, a senior retainer of the domain, went up to Tokyo in 1875 to petition for a postponement of the stipend commutation and was refused; back in Hagi he became commander of the Go-koku-tai and directed the operation as a whole and the dealings with the government troops. Mitsuoka Hachiro, a fencing master in the service of the domain, joined as commander of the Shinkoku-tai, and was the radical who first insisted that force be used to wrench concessions out of the government. Sasaki Isamu, a former retainer, went south to work in the Satsuma camp, was arrested by the authorities before the rising, and committed suicide in prison in 1876. The young samurai Higashiyama Mitsuru is said to have taken part in the plotting; he was arrested and punished afterwards and later became a figure in the civil-rights movement. On the government side, Home Minister Saneomi Sanjo and War Minister Iwao Oyama held the civil and military portfolios respectively, while the actual direction of the suppression fell to Inspector-General of the Garrisons Aritomo Yamagata, who insisted on ending the revolt with the new state army rather than with the swords of the old domain retainers.
kits: 這張卡的兵器是鐵甲艦，也就是一八六二年前後英國海軍的新一代主力艦。英國不列顛戰艦號於一八六〇年動工、一八六二年完工，排水量約九千噸，舷側與水線敷設四英寸半鍛鐵裝甲帶，主砲為四門十英寸來福線滑膛前膛砲；同年三月美國漢普頓海戰中，聯邦軍監視者號與南方軍維吉尼亞號兩艘鐵甲艦首次在海上互射，雙方都未能全殲對手，從此各國砲塔、裝甲厚度與裝甲帶的佈置都圍著「先打穿還是先打不穿」重做。技術外溢到日本走的是另一條線：一八七六年的日本海軍成立未滿十年，一八七五年才從英國購得鐵骨武裝汽船對馬號與敷高號，同年由橫須賀造船所造出千代丸，真正裝甲的主力艦扶桑號要一八七七年才向英國訂造、一八七九年抵日，三笠號更要到一八八二年才到日本。因此萩之亂的戰場上完全沒有海軍介入，鎮壓全靠陸上步兵與警察。卡上這門砲象徵的，正是亂局的根源：當火器與軍制換代，舊式身份與舊式武器一起貶值，這與徵兵令、秩祿處分對士族的衝擊是同一件事。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the ironclad, the new capital ship of the British navy around 1862. H.M.S. Warrior was laid down in 1860 and completed in 1862, displacing about nine thousand tons, with wrought-iron belt armour four and a half inches thick along the side and at the waterline and a main battery of four ten-inch rifled muzzle-loading guns; in the Battle of Hampton Roads in March of that same year, the Union monitor Monitor and the Confederate Virginia met in the first engagement between armoured warships, neither side destroying the other, and from that point the turret, the thickness of the plate and the disposition of the belt in every navy were redesigned around the question of whether shell or armour would win. The transmission of that technology to Japan ran along a different line. The Japanese navy was less than ten years old in 1876; it bought the iron-hulled armed steamers Tsushima and Shikoku from Britain in 1875 and built the Chiyomaru at the Yokosuka arsenal in the same year, while the first true armoured capital ship, Fuso, was not ordered from Britain until 1877 and only reached Japan in 1879, and Mikasa did not arrive until 1882. No navy took part in the Hagi revolt; the suppression was fought entirely by infantry and police on land. What the gun on this card stands for is the real source of the disturbance: when ordnance and military system change generation, the old kind of identity and the old kind of weapon are depreciated together, and that is the same process the Conscription Act and the stipend commutation worked on the samurai.
tactics: 叛軍的打法是先奪文書、後守隘口。二月十四日拂曉，護國隊與神國隊同時攻入萩郡役所，縱火燒毀徵祿、戶籍與武備的簿冊，並攻掠萩町的稅關與警察官吏住宅；隨即以總門為根據點，把總門內側的石垣與町屋改造成壘塞，沿山陽道與山陰道方向派出哨騎，切斷從山口、徳山方向來的官軍偵察與驛傳消息，據當時記錄，電信線也曾被剪斷。官軍並不急於強攻，先以警察隊與補充兵封住山口、玖珂方向的街道與鄰近海岸的渡口，再集中兵力逐次攻略三隅、徳山、豐浦等外圍據點，逼叛軍退守總門一線。五月，官軍在總門外的制高點架起山炮，連續數日直射，砲火擊毀石垣與門樓；五月十四日，步兵在炮擊掩護下強行突入，叛軍陣線當日崩潰。官軍全程以封鎖、斷糧、炮擊換取巷戰傷亡，最後一役才投入兵力。
tacticsEn: The rebels' method was to seize the paperwork first and the defiles second. In the small hours of 14 February the Go-koku-tai and the Shinkoku-tai stormed the Hagi district office, set fire to the registers of stipend, household and armament, and raided the tax office and the police officials' houses in the town; they then made the Somon their base, converting the stone ramparts and the town houses inside the gate into barricades, and posted outriders along the routes toward the San'yo and San'in roads to cut off government reconnaissance and the mounted post coming from the Yamaguchi and Tokuyama side, contemporary records also noting that the telegraph line was cut. The government did not rush the assault. Police and conscripted reserves first sealed the roads toward Yamaguchi and Kuga and the coastal crossings nearby, and the troops were then concentrated in turn on the outer positions at Misumi, Tokuyama and Toyoura, driving the rebels back onto the single line of the Somon. In May the government dug in mountain guns on the heights outside the gate and fired day after day; the shot smashed the rampart and the gatehouse, and on 14 May the infantry went in under cover of the guns and the rebel line collapsed the same day. Throughout, the government traded casualties for blockade, denial of food and artillery, and only committed its strength in the final assault.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。起義與鎮壓的時序最為確定：一八七六年二月十四日拂曉蜂起，五月十四日總門陷落，前後九十天，跨越早春到初夏，萩一帶的雨與山霧多次影響官軍炮擊的精度與夜間移動。兵員方面，蜂起當夜直接投入的武裝者約五六百人，多為持有舊式火槍與刀的藩士，之後因徳山、長門一帶舊士族聞風加入，總門一線聚到千人上下；官軍投入數個步兵大隊、補充兵、鎮台炮兵與山口縣警察隊，總數約三千人，兵力對比約三比一。財政與軍制的數字同樣有跡可循：秩祿處分把士族俸祿折成一次性給付，以年息五厘與一分的國債抵押支付，總支出被估計在三千數百萬兩圓的量級；一八七三年徵兵令規定的現役期通常記載為三年。兵裝方面，官軍步槍以一八七二年定型的村田十八式為主並附刺刀，輔以射手用青銅炮與山炮；叛軍則無統一制式火器，槍械型號混雜且彈藥不足。工事方面，總門的石垣築於一六〇四年毛利重就築城之時，是這場衝突中唯一現代式永久工事，也因此成為雙方爭奪的核心。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The sequence is the most certain element: the rising began in the small hours of 14 February 1876, the Somon fell on 14 May, and the whole affair ran for ninety days, from early spring into early summer, through a season of rain and hill fog in the Hagi area that repeatedly spoiled the accuracy of the government guns and the movement of troops at night. On strength, some five or six hundred armed men went into the first assault, mostly former retainers with old muskets and blades, and the numbers on the Somon line later reached around a thousand as former samurai from Tokuyama and the Nagato district joined in. The government committed several infantry battalions, conscripted reserves, garrison artillery and the police detachments of the Yamaguchi prefectural government, about three thousand men in all, a ratio of roughly three to one. The fiscal and military figures behind the rising are equally traceable: the stipend commutation turned the samurai's hereditary stipend into a single payment, secured against government bonds yielding five and ten per cent, at a total outlay estimated in the low tens of millions of ryo; the Conscription Act of 1873 is usually recorded as fixing a three-year term of active service. In the way of equipment, government infantry carried the Type 18 Murata rifle settled on in 1872, with bayonet, supported by bronze breech-loading guns and mountain pieces, while the rebels had no standard arm at all, their muskets of mixed patterns running short of ammunition. In the way of works, the stone rampart of the Somon was built in 1604 when Mori Shigetoshi founded the castle; it was the only modern permanent work in the field, and for that reason it became the object both sides fought over.
cause: 萩之亂不是孤立的偶發事件，而是明治政府廢藩置縣之後，一整套財政與軍制改革在毛利支藩內地引爆的衝突。幕末的尊王倒幕運動已把萩藩這家長州支藩消耗殆盡：第二次長州征伐之後藩主被幽囚江戶，藩政由鎮台接管，家臣團對朝廷的疑慮並未隨新政府成立而消失。一八七一年廢藩置縣使萩藩在法律上消失，一八七三年公佈、一八七六年實施的秩祿處分，把藩士世襲俸祿折算成一次性給付，其間五年的利息負擔迫使許多萩藩家庭變賣家傳刀劍與武具抵押借款，這是引爆民心最直接的一根導火線。與此同時，一八七三年的徵兵令把徵兵權收歸國家，一八七六年的修正又把役齡往下調，舊藩武士引以為傲的世襲軍人身分與佩刀特權被逐步取消。恰恰是那些在一八六二年薩長同盟時倚賴新式火器與新式軍隊的長州藩士，在一八七〇年代中期被新體制解除武裝。起義前一年的上京請願未獲答覆，加上海內對薩摩方面蠢動的傳聞，最終把積怨轉成一八七六年二月十四日的武裝蜂起。
causeEn: The Hagi revolt was not an isolated accident but the eruption inside a Mori branch domain of a whole set of fiscal and military reforms the Meiji government carried through after abolishing the han. The anti-shogunate movement of the closing years of the shogunate had already spent Hagi, a branch of Choshu, almost entirely: after the Second Choshu Expedition the lord was confined in Edo and the domain was administered by the garrison, and the suspicion the retainers felt toward the court did not vanish when the new government came into being. The abolition of the han in 1871 destroyed Hagi in law; the stipend commutation, promulgated in 1873 and carried out in 1876, turned hereditary domain stipends into a single payment, and the heavy interest burden over the intervening years forced many Hagi households to pawn or sell the family swords and weapons they held, and that was the most direct fuse. At the same time the Conscription Act of 1873 vested the right to conscript in the state, and the revision of 1876 lowered the age of service further, so the hereditary military status of the old samurai and their privilege of wearing swords were abolished step by step. The Choshu retainers who had relied on modern ordnance and modern drill in the Satsuma-Choshu alliance of 1862 were exactly the men whom the new system disarmed in the middle of the 1870s. The petition carried to Tokyo a year before the rising was turned down, and rumours of Saisho activity along the coasts fed the grievance, until on 14 February 1876 it turned into an armed revolt.
impact: 萩之亂在明治國家形成的時間軸上，是第一次用新制軍隊壓服舊藩士的戰役，這一點使它的意義超出地方藩的範圍。鎮壓成功之後，廢藩置縣、鎮台制與徵兵制的正當性再無對手：同年八月政府頒佈廢刀令，十一月把萩縣併入新設的山口縣，一整套把藩與藩士收編為國民的動作得以在毫無異議的情況下推進；一年後的西南之戰中，一般記載薩摩同盟軍兵力約四萬、官軍動員約九萬，而背後的家臣團在精神上早已被萩之亂的失敗瓦解，這是兩役之間最容易被忽略的連續性。處分從輕也是有意為之：多數舊藩士被判罰金、杖刑或流刑後仍留鄉，郡役所與警察的重建依賴熟悉地情與文書的舊藩吏員，萩藩的人才庫因此沒有被一次性斷裂。損失則是實物的：郡役所的簿冊焚毀使萩藩的公文書散佚不全，總門的石垣與門樓在炮火中損毀，現存石垣與重建門樓分屬不同年代，萩城因此少了一件完整無缺的初期建築。名號上，護國隊與神國隊這兩個稱呼進入明治時期的政治語彙，參與其中的若干青年日後轉入自由民權運動，讓一次地方性的藩士叛乱，成為早期國民黨運動的隱性伏線。
impactEn: On the timeline of the formation of the Meiji state, the Hagi revolt was the first war in which the new state army put down the old domain samurai, and that gave the event a significance wider than one small domain. After the suppression nothing stood in the way of the abolition of the han, the garrison system or conscription: in August the government issued the edict banning the carrying of swords, in November it merged Hagi prefecture into the newly created Yamaguchi prefecture, and the whole series of measures that folded the domain and its retainers into subjects could be pushed through without effective opposition. In the Satsuma Rebellion of the following year the usual estimates put the Satsuma-Choshu army at around forty thousand and the government levy at about ninety thousand, but the retainer community behind it had already been broken in spirit by Hagi, and that continuity between the two campaigns is easily overlooked. The sentences were deliberately light: most of the former retainers received fines, caning or exile and then stayed in the country, and the reconstruction of the district office and the police depended on old domain officials who knew the local records and the local terrain, so the Hagi talent pool was not wiped out in one stroke. The losses were of a material kind. The registers burned in the district office left the Hagi documentary archive scattered and incomplete; the rampart and gatehouse of the Somon were destroyed by artillery, and the surviving masonry and the rebuilt gatehouse belong to different centuries, so Hagi Castle has lost one of its few intact early structures. In terms of vocabulary, the names Go-koku-tai and Shinkoku-tai entered the political language of the Meiji period, and several of the young men who had taken part later turned to the civil-rights movement, turning a local rising of domain samurai into a hidden prelude to the early nationalist party politics.
result: 一八七六年五月十四日，被炮火摧毀的總門被官軍突破，叛軍在石垣與町屋之間的抵抗當日瓦解。前田利右衛門在總門附近切腹，三岡八郎負傷被俘，於一八七七年在獄中病逝；佐々木勇已在起義前切腹，頭山滿等數人被捕後受刑，往後走上不同的政治道路。官軍隨後解除戒嚴，進駐萩町，郡役所在焚毀的舊址上重建，山口縣廳的建制也因之重新整理地方行政。參與者的處分以罰金、杖刑與流刑為主，無人被判死刑，鎮壓行動的軍事與司法兩面都刻意收著，這既顯示新政府確已握有生殺予奪之權，也顯示它仍需要士族來運作新國家。從全局看，這場三個月的對峙以叛軍的失敗告終，但它證實了一件事：明治政府能夠用新制軍隊在國內把任何一支舊式武裝壓下去，此後再沒有藩士能以武力向政府提出要求。
resultEn: On 14 May 1876 the Somon, broken by artillery, was carried by the government troops, and the rebel resistance among the ramparts and town houses collapsed the same day. Maeda Tsuemon committed suicide near the gate, Mitsuoka Hachiro was wounded and taken, and died in prison in 1877; Sasaki Isamu had already killed himself before the rising, while Higashiyama Mitsuru and a few others were arrested and punished and afterwards went their separate political ways. The government then lifted the martial law, moved into the town of Hagi and rebuilt the district office on the site of the burned one, and the administrative structure of the Yamaguchi prefectural government was reorganised around the episode. The sentences handed out were fines, caning and exile, with no death sentences; both the military and the judicial sides of the suppression were deliberately restrained, which showed at once that the new government held the power of life and death and that it still needed the samurai to run the new state. In the wider view the three-month stand ended in defeat for the rebels, but it proved one thing: the Meiji government could use the new army to crush any armed old-style force inside the country, and after that no retainer could make a demand of the government by force of arms.
